title: Employment Situation (Apr 2027 data) — 08:30 ET, two days after the May quarterly refunding announcement and four days before its auctions
source: EST: derived from BLS's own published scheduling rule — the Employment Situation is released on the third Friday following the end of the reference week (the Sun-Sat week containing the 12th). THE RULE WAS RE-IMPLEMENTED AND RE-VALIDATED FROM SCRATCH BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed RESEARCH (2026-09-09) rather than inherited from the proposal: 7 for 7 against the four confirmed jobs-* entries on this calendar (2026-09-04, 2026-10-02, 2026-11-06, 2026-12-04) and the three historical Sunday-July-4 releases (2004-07-02, 2010-07-02, 2021-07-02). For April 2027 the reference week is Sun 2027-04-11 to Sat 2027-04-17, and the third Friday after 04-17 is 2027-05-07. The prefix is EST: and not BLS: because bls.gov 403s this runner: /schedule/news_release/2027_sched.htm, /schedule/news_release/empsit.htm and /bls/news-release/empsit.htm all returned HTTP 403 to curl under a browser user-agent on 2026-09-09, and fred.stlouisfed.org/release/dates?rid=50 (the fallback release-date register) returned 404 — every one recorded in this event's probe-ref.blocked. A web search on 2026-09-09 returns no 2027 BLS schedule at all. 2027-05-07 is an ordinary full NYSE session with no holiday within a week of it, so the rule's one documented failure mode (a derived Friday landing on a closed session) cannot fire. A derived date is not a published one
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed RESEARCH (2026-09-09), superseding proposals/jobs-2027-05-07.from-treasury-borrowing-estimates-2027-05-03.json, which stays where it is and is now shadowed. THE GEOMETRY THE PROPOSAL NAMED IS STRUCTURAL, NOT INCIDENTAL, AND THAT WAS MEASURED HERE: across 1993-2026, 116 of the 120 payroll Fridays that publish in a refunding month (Feb/May/Aug/Nov) land 4-6 calendar days ahead of the quarterly 3y/10y/30y refunding auctions, 93 of them at exactly 5 -- verified against Treasury's own primary auctions_query API (api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov, HTTP 200 2026-09-09, 663 auction records across the three tenors back to 1979). So 2027-05-07 is a RECURRING shape, not a one-off collision: D+2 from treasury-refunding-2027-05-05 (est) and D+4..D+6 from the auctions that sell what that announcement sizes. TWO OTHER STRUCTURAL FACTS, neither in the proposal. (1) It is the FIRST payroll after fomc-2027-04-28 (est, D+9) and NOT the last before fomc-2027-06-09 (est) -- the same 7-for-7 rule puts the May 2027 Employment Situation on 2027-06-04, five days before that meeting and inside the blackout that opens 2027-05-29 (jobs-2027-06-04 proposed in the same PR). (2) It would be the EARLIEST 2027 payroll this calendar carries; the tracked set jumps from here to 2027-07-02. MEASURED THIS SESSION on Yahoo split/dividend-adjusted daily bars, 1993-2026, over TLT/IEF/SHY/LQD/AGG/SPY/GLD: looming refunding supply does NOT change the payroll's own print-day reaction -- refunding-week payrolls move 0.96-1.09x an ordinary payroll Friday across all seven instruments, every permutation p between 0.47 and 0.98, which REFUTES the intuitive 'supply overhang amplifies the print' story. The 5-session carry window that CONTAINS the auctions looks compressed against the pooled baseline (IEF 0.72x p=0.016, AGG 0.68x p=0.015, LQD 0.77x p=0.040) but does NOT survive its own within-season control -- against the very next 5 sessions of the same month, only LQD clears (p=0.031; TLT 0.71, IEF 0.29, AGG 0.51, SPY 0.22) -- so it is carried as MIXED and registered as a forward test, not as a call. The 30y refunding auction session itself is not a volatility event (TLT 0.542% vs a 0.675% matched control, p=0.26; all five instruments null). Direction is unpredictable throughout (TLT continuation 42/93, p=0.41). Impact high matches every other jobs-* entry on this calendar; symbols [] matches them too. Estimates widen caution and license no entry.
